hero.headline: Privacy Policy
hero.subtext: How we collect, use, and protect your data.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.body:
When you create an account, we collect your name, email address, and profile information provided through our authentication service (Clerk). When you create events, we store event details such as title, date, location, and description.

For guests who RSVP, we collect the information the event organizer requests — typically name, email, and any custom questions set by the organizer. Guests do not need to create an Duhuze RSVP account to respond.
sections.callout: We only collect information that is necessary to provide and improve the service.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.body:
We use your information to:

• Provide, maintain, and improve the Duhuze RSVP platform
• Send transactional emails (invitations, RSVP confirmations, reminders)
• Communicate with you about your account or events
• Analyze usage patterns to improve the product

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.title: Data Sharing
sections.body:
We share your data only with service providers that help us operate the platform:

• Clerk — authentication and user management
• Neon — database hosting (PostgreSQL)
• Resend — transactional email delivery
• Hostinger — application hosting

Each provider is bound by their own privacy policies and data processing agreements. We do not share guest data with anyone other than the event organizer who invited them.

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.body:
We retain your account data for as long as your account is active. Event and guest data is retained for as long as the organizer's account exists. If you delete your account, we remove your personal data within 30 days, except where required by law.

Guest RSVP data is associated with the event organizer's account. Guests can request removal of their data by contacting the event organizer or by emailing us directly.

sections.title: Cookies and Tracking
sections.body:
We use essential cookies for authentication and session management. We do not use advertising cookies or third-party trackers.

Our analytics are minimal and focused on aggregate usage patterns — we do not build individual user profiles for advertising.
sections.callout: We use only essential cookies. No advertising trackers, ever.

sections.title: Security
sections.body:
We take reasonable measures to protect your data, including:

• Encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS) for all data in transit
• Encrypted database storage at rest
• Session tokens with automatic expiration
• Role-based access controls for administrative functions

No system is perfectly secure. If you discover a vulnerability, please contact us at operations@izyodigital.com.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.body:
You have the right to:

• Access the personal data we hold about you
• Correct inaccurate data
• Request deletion of your data
• Export your event and guest data
• Withdraw consent for optional communications

To exercise any of these rights, contact us at operations@izyodigital.com.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. When we make significant changes, we'll notify you by email or through a notice on the platform. Continued use of Duhuze RSVP after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body:
If you have questions about this privacy policy or our data practices, contact us at:

• Email: operations@izyodigital.com
• General inquiries: info@rsvp-duhuze.com

hero.headline: Terms of Service
hero.subtext: The rules and guidelines for using Duhuze RSVP.

sections.title: Acceptance of Terms
sections.body:
By accessing or using Duhuze RSVP ("the Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, do not use the Service.

These terms apply to all users, including event organizers, guests, and visitors.

sections.title: Account Responsibilities
sections.body:
You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and for all activity that occurs under it. You must:

• Provide accurate information when creating your account
• Keep your login credentials secure
• Notify us immediately of any unauthorized access
• Not share your account with others

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.
sections.callout: You are responsible for all activity under your account.

sections.title: Acceptable Use
sections.body:
You agree not to use Duhuze RSVP to:

• Violate any applicable laws or regulations
• Send spam, phishing, or unsolicited communications
• Upload malicious code, viruses, or harmful content
• Impersonate another person or entity
• Collect personal information from guests for purposes unrelated to your event
• Interfere with or disrupt the Service

We may remove content or suspend accounts that violate these guidelines.

sections.title: Event Organizer Obligations
sections.body:
As an event organizer, you are responsible for:

• The accuracy of your event information
• Obtaining appropriate consent from guests whose information you collect
• Using guest data only for purposes related to your event
• Complying with applicable data protection laws in your jurisdiction

Duhuze RSVP provides tools for event management but is not a party to any agreements between organizers and their guests.

sections.title: Guest Data
sections.body:
Event organizers collect guest information through Duhuze RSVP. As a guest:

• Your information is shared with the event organizer who invited you
• You can request removal of your data by contacting the organizer or us
• You do not need to create an Duhuze RSVP account to RSVP

Organizers are responsible for how they use guest data outside of the Duhuze RSVP platform.

sections.title: Payments and Billing
sections.body:
Paid plans are billed in advance on a monthly or annual basis in RWF. Prices are subject to change with 30 days' notice.

• You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time
• Upgrades take effect after successful payment
• Downgrades and cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing period
• We do not offer automated refunds at this time
• Free plans have no time limit but are subject to usage limits

sections.title: Intellectual Property
sections.body:
Duhuze RSVP and its original content, features, and functionality are owned by Duhuze RSVP and are protected by copyright and other intellectual property laws.

You retain ownership of any content you upload to the Service (event details, images, guest lists). By uploading content, you grant us a license to store, display, and transmit it as necessary to provide the Service.

sections.title: Service Availability
sections.body:
We strive to keep Duhuze RSVP available at all times but do not guarantee uninterrupted access. We may temporarily suspend the Service for maintenance, updates, or circumstances beyond our control.

We are not liable for any loss or damage resulting from service interruptions.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
sections.body:
To the maximum extent permitted by law, Duhuze RSVP shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages resulting from your use of the Service.

Our total liability for any claim arising from these terms shall not exceed the amount you paid us in the 12 months preceding the claim.
sections.callout: Our liability is limited to the fees you have paid in the preceding 12 months.

sections.title: Termination
sections.body:
You can delete your account at any time. We may terminate or suspend your account if you violate these terms.

Upon termination, your right to use the Service ceases immediately. We will retain your data for 30 days after account deletion, after which it is permanently removed.

sections.title: Changes to Terms
sections.body:
We may update these terms from time to time. When we make material changes, we will notify you by email or through a notice on the platform.

Continued use of Duhuze RSVP after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms. If you disagree with the changes, you should stop using the Service.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body:
For questions about these terms, contact us at:

• General inquiries: info@rsvp-duhuze.com
